def transform(grid):
    bg = grid[0][0]
    shapes = {}
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        for c, v in enumerate(row):
            if v != bg:
                shapes.setdefault(v, []).append((r, c))
    fill_color = min(shapes, key=lambda v: len(shapes[v]))
    candidates = [v for v in shapes if v != fill_color and len(shapes[v]) >= 8]
    color = min(candidates, key=lambda v: len(shapes[v]))
    cells = shapes[color]
    top = min(r for r, c in cells)
    bottom = max(r for r, c in cells)
    left = min(c for r, c in cells)
    right = max(c for r, c in cells)
    width = right - left + 1
    stem_col = next(c for c in range(left, right + 1)
                    if sum(grid[r][c] == color for r in range(top, bottom + 1)) >= 3
                    and any(grid[r][c] != color for r in range(top, bottom + 1)))
    return [[color if r in (top, bottom) or c == stem_col else fill_color
             for c in range(left, right + 1)] for r in range(top, bottom + 1)]
